description: Default agent search: Goal -> Buyer Role -> Buyer Scope -> Need -> Trigger -> Seller Exclusion -> Search Terms -> FIT/NEED/NOW.

district.description: Optional district or local administrative area.
district.title: District

goal.description: Original user sales/lead request verbatim. REQUIRED. AlpineLead derives buyer role, buyer scope, need, current trigger and seller exclusions from this context.
goal.title: Goal

industry.description: Optional explicit target buyer industry/company category. If provided, it constrains the buyer scope.
industry.title: Industry

language.description: Human-readable opportunity analysis language: de, en, es or fr.
language.title: Language

max_credits.description: Optional hard user credit ceiling. Textual credit caps in goal are also enforced.
max_credits.title: Max Credits

offer_prompt.description: Optional explicit description of what the user sells. If omitted, goal becomes the semantic Buyer Role / Need / Trigger context and is never null internally.
offer_prompt.title: Offer Prompt

region.description: Optional target state, province or canton.
region.title: Region

save_to_history.description: Save only accepted opportunities to AlpineLead CRM/history.
save_to_history.title: Save To History

name: find_opportunities
title: Find QUALIFIED DACH opportunities · default agent search
